observations: ResourceCRUDController.submit takes asset URN, knowledge class, submission mode, serialized contents and principal; its inspected signature is not an expected-document-revision CAS/validation-ticket/conditional-publication contract.

ResourcesProviderController.MARK_PUBLISHED passes resource URN, service ID and authoritativeResourceUrn to markPublished. This is not evidence of atomic validated namespace-source publication and must not be repurposed as such.

ResourcesProvider.submit explicitly returns an Error ResourceSet for PUBLISH of non-Resource assets, including namespaces. UPDATE_DEFERRED delegates ontology/namespace saves and VALIDATE operates on a workspace; neither inspected branch establishes this generic expected-document-revision conditional publication protocol.
Existing production Authoring remains explicit ADD-only and RevisionDrafts remain UNVALIDATED_PRIVATE_DRAFT; no unsafe UPDATE or automatic publication was added to them.

AcceptedDocuments/AsyncAcceptedDocuments is a separately proposed reference. Every call requires exact caller opt-in and selected Resources acceptedDocumentProtocol advertisement; no management endpoint is attempted on ordinary unadvertised Java services.
Reference server owns source revisions, diagnostics and atomic current source/knowledge publication conditions. Python DTOs or caller-supplied validations do not grant publication authority.

Independent reference accepts eight declared namespace identities and exact literal valid sources, keeps bounded histories/publication snapshots and owner root cleanup. It is not a parser/compiler, executable-model admission or native Resources catalog publication.
required_native_contract: Maintainer-confirmed source revision/expected-version transport, ownership/authorization, semantic knowledge binding, conditional publication/retention and approved disposable native fixtures before management compatibility runs
